facts.fact: Echorouk reports a media day on 12 May 2025 for the official announcement of the National Digital Transformation Strategy, which the High Commissioner called the 'approved strategy', naming no approving act.

The strategy's five axes carry targets: more than five national data centres, 500,000 ICT experts, 40% less skilled emigration, no cash payments above 500,000 DZD and 20% of GDP from the digital economy; no cost is stated.
The Minister and High Commissioner for Digitalisation presented the strategy as the organising framework for the digital transformation process.
